msg: cloud block: state and runs live in HCP Terraform. The HCP Terraform Free plan stops at 500 managed resources and 1 concurrent run, and OpenTofu cannot use a cloud block and a state backend in the same configuration.
fix: Back up state first (terraform state pull > backup.tfstate), move it to an s3, gcs, azurerm or pg backend, then run tofu init and tofu plan and expect "No changes".

msg: backend "remote": state is stored in HCP Terraform (Free plan: 500 managed resources, 1 concurrent run).
fix: terraform state pull > backup.tfstate, switch to an s3, gcs, azurerm or pg backend, then tofu init -migrate-state and tofu plan.

msg: terraform_remote_state reads another configuration's state from HCP Terraform. OpenTofu's guide for interdependent configurations treats every terraform_remote_state link as a migration dependency.
fix: Migrate the producing configuration's state first, then point backend and config here at the new bucket or database.

msg: Module from the HCP Terraform private registry (app.terraform.io). tofu init needs an HCP token to fetch it, so the module stays tied to the HCP organization.
fix: Publish the module from its Git repo and use source = "git::https://<host>/<org>/<module>.git?ref=vX.Y.Z".

msg: hashicorp/tfe manages HCP Terraform itself (workspaces, variables, teams). These resources have nothing to manage once state has left HCP Terraform.
fix: Remove the tfe_* resources with a removed block or tofu state rm after the state move, and delete the tfe provider requirement.

msg: Provider source written with the registry.terraform.io host. The OpenTofu migration guide's tofu init step downloads providers from the OpenTofu registry, which only applies to host-less sources.
fix: Write the source without a host, e.g. source = "hashicorp/aws", then run tofu init -upgrade and commit the new .terraform.lock.hcl.

msg: required_version excludes OpenTofu 1.11.14: OpenTofu 1.11 and earlier check required_version against the OpenTofu version, so tofu init stops on this Terraform pin.
fix: Keep the Terraform pin in versions.tf and add versions.tofu with language { compatible_with { opentofu = ">= 1.12" } } (OpenTofu 1.12+); when both files exist OpenTofu ignores versions.tf.

msg: required_version asks for Terraform 1.6.0 or later, which is Business Source License code: the Terraform LICENSE covers "Terraform Version 1.6.0 or later" (Licensor: IBM).
fix: Record the Terraform pin for Terraform only and declare OpenTofu support in versions.tofu: language { compatible_with { opentofu = ">= 1.12" } }.

msg: provider_meta block: OpenTofu accepts it for compatibility but silently ignores it instead of sending its data to the provider.
fix: Delete it, or move the data it carries into provider or resource arguments.

msg: CI installs HashiCorp Terraform (hashicorp/setup-terraform, latest v4.0.1), so pipeline runs keep executing BSL Terraform after the switch.
fix: uses: opentofu/setup-opentofu@v2 (latest v2.0.2) with tofu_version: 1.12.6, and rename terraform commands to tofu.

msg: Container image hashicorp/terraform: the pipeline or runner still ships HashiCorp Terraform.
fix: Use ghcr.io/opentofu/opentofu:1.12.6 (current stable, released 2026-08-19) and call tofu.

msg: terraform CLI call: this step runs whatever terraform binary is on the PATH.
fix: Call tofu with the same subcommand (tofu init, tofu plan, tofu apply).

msg: HCP Terraform token or organization variable: it only serves app.terraform.io.
fix: After the state move, revoke the HCP team or user token and delete the variable from CI secrets.
